description: AI Guidelines for modifications to this project

fileOrganization.description: All markdown (.md) documentation and report files must be stored in storage/docs/ folder
exceptions: README.md - Standard project readme (stays in root)
fileOrganization.implementation: Move any .md files to storage/docs/ before committing
fileOrganization.reasoning: Keeps project root clean, separates generated reports from source code, maintains clean git history

codeQuality.description: Do not add extra features, refactoring, or abstractions beyond what the task requires
examples: Bug fix does not need surrounding cleanup
One-shot operation doesn't need helper functions
Don't design for hypothetical future requirements
Three similar lines are better than premature abstraction

comments.description: Only add comments when the WHY is non-obvious
when_to_add: Behavior that would surprise a reader
avoid: Explaining WHAT code does (well-named identifiers handle this)
Referencing current task or PR (belongs in commit message)

errorHandling.description: Don't add error handling for scenarios that can't happen
errorHandling.implementation: Trust internal code and framework guarantees; validate only at system boundaries (user input, external APIs)

databaseError.action: Do NOT fix - pre-existing DB/env mismatch, not related to project changes

gitCommit.description: AI models must NEVER automatically commit changes to git
requirements: ALWAYS stage changes and show diff to user
ALWAYS wait for explicit user approval before committing
ALWAYS display commit message for review
ALWAYS ask: 'Ready to commit? [y/n]' before running git commit
gitCommit.violationRisk: Loss of work, unintended commits, overwriting user changes, breaking production

beforeModifying: Check storage/docs/ for any existing project documentation
Review .git status to understand current state
If creating documentation/reports, use storage/docs/ directory
Keep changes minimal and focused on the stated task

gitCommitFormat.template:
Brief description of change

Co-Authored-By: [AI Model Name] <noreply@[model-provider].com>
gitCommitFormat.example:
Add hero section frames to 10 inner pages

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
